name: Kuroya Yuzuru
source:
Hinagami Hideomi’s second son, who married into the Kuroya Clinic. He’s [url=/c11247]Naori’s[/url] father. 

He shares responsibility for the health of his neighbors with his father-in-law, [url=/c11307]Sou[/url]. 

"...If you’ve got that kind of energy, I think you’ll live ’til a hundred, dad." 

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?product_code=139]MangaGamer[/url]]
